title: FaiveleyTech invests EUR 15 million in a new beauty manufacturing facility
summary: Inaugurated on October 15 in Orgelet, in France's Jura region, the new 10,000 m² industrial site is designed to double assembly capacity and increase plastic injection capacity by 30%. It will strengthen FaiveleyTech's production capabilities in high-value-added technical polymer injection moulding and decoration.
